name: Feedback Technology Corp.
summary: Feedback Technology Corp. manufactures, processes, and sells components for semiconductor, LCD, LED, medical, display, solar, and aerospace industries in Taiwan. The company offers high precision machining, such as ion implanter, optical silicon/quartz, and stainless steel/AI parts. It also provides integration services, including zone controller box, cryo pump and e-chuck repair/overhaul, HOT N2 heater system, mechatronics engineering service, PTFE heating jacket, silicon rubber heating jacket, touch panel controller box, and turbo pump repair/overhaul.
